summary: Pass structured MCP write parameters to the FedEx HTTP client so request bodies are JSON-encoded exactly once.
reason: The FedEx MCP pre-marshaled write parameters before calling a client that marshals request bodies, causing shipment and other write bodies to arrive as base64 JSON strings instead of JSON objects.
validated_outcome: Unit and handler-level mock-server tests confirm both orchestration and generic handlers send top-level JSON objects with their structured fields intact.
